The map has moved to its own full-screen page: [open the interactive map](map/index.html).

Hourly anthropogenic heat on a 100 m grid, for four snapshot years of the adoption model.
Step the year to watch waste heat grow as households buy air conditioners; drag the day
curve to see the evening peak build. Click any cell for its value across all four years.

**Reading it.** The island city and the eastern suburbs carry the highest values; SGNP,
Aarey and the creeks are empty because no buildings sit there. Cell-level variance is real
rather than noise — a 100 m cell holding one tower differs sharply from its neighbour
holding three chawls — but at this resolution the picture is grainier than a published
Q~f~ atlas would normally be shown.
